programme.title: RONDA RODA
programme.desc: Musim ke-6 Ronda Roda bermula dengan sorotan istimewa! Sesi ditutup dengan hasil tangan kreatif daripada Epy Design dalam satu lagi paparan Gegar Garaj.

programme.title: HOMEGROWN SHOW
programme.desc: Homegrown Show kali ini kembali dengan artis dan kugiran lokal tanah air anda. Episod ini memaparkan artis The Peachskins.

programme.title: PODCAST LAGENDA
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama penyampai radio terkenal, Linda Onn. Beliau mengupas cabaran, tekanan industri, dan detik jatuh bangun yang membentuk kematangannya. Beliau turut berkongsi momen penting yang menjadi titik perubahan kerjaya serta pencapaian membanggakan sepanjang bergelar anak seni.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kika dan Igo, sepasang kekasih yang bertemu melalui aplikasi kencan, namun menghadapi komplikasi rumit ketika orang tua mereka menikah. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh ikatan persaudaraan tiri dan penolakan orang tua.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Tengku Maria menjadi semakin bimbang melihat keadaan Iskandar yang semakin tidak bermaya dan tidak terurus. Dia minta Haziq untuk kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan menasihati Iskandar, namum Haziq enggan pulang selagi dia tidak dapat membawa Aisyah pulang bersama. Haziq juga masih terluka dengan ungkitan yang disebut oleh Iskandar tentang asal usulnya. Iskandar masih menanti dan sentiasa mencari Aisyahy, setiap malam dia bermimpi akan Aisyah yang datang menemuinya dan kembali semula ke kondo itu. Iskandar kesal, dia nekad untuk menebus segala khilafnya sekiranya Aisyah kembali kepadanya. Aisyah masih enggan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur, dia bertegas bahawa dia tidak mengenali Haziq dan sesiapa di Kuala Lumpur itu. Anim dan Azri cuba meyakinkan Aisyah namun sering kali gagal. Tanpa diduga, Rokiah dan Sarip berat hati untuk melepaskan Aisyah pergi. Di sebalik layanan baik Rokiah dan Sarip terhadap Aisyah, sebenarnya mereka pernah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka ketika berusia 6 tahun akibat kemalangan jalan raya. disebabkan itu mereka sangat menyanyangi Aisyah dan bersyukur ingatan Aisyah membolehkan Aisyah kembali kepada memori dia bersama arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk memberitahu hal itu kepada Tengku Maria, berita itu membuatkan Tengku Maria gembira dan tidak sabar untuk menyambut kepulangan Aisyah. Namun Haziq tidak memberitahu perihal ingatan Aisyah yang sudah hilang memorinya. Anim, Azri, Rokiah, Sarip dan Amani bersetuju untuk bersama membawa Aisyah ke Kuala Lumpur demi menjamin keselamatan Aisyah dan kejujuran Haziq yang mahu Aisyah pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.(n)

Dia telah melukakan hati Syarfan namun setelah hati Syarfan terubat dengan kehadiran Antasya dia cuba merampas Syarfan semula. Syarfan dan Nazreth bebincang. Nazareth mengakui dia menyukai Antasya . Namun perasaan suka tersebut menjadi hormat apabila melihat hati luhur Antasya. Syarfan dan Antasya juga saling berdamai.(n)

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan antara Tengku Maria dan keluarga baharu Aisyah memberi kesan yang mendalam buat diri Tengku Maria, alangkah hinanya dia sebagai seorang manusia yang menjadi penyebab wanita yang tidak bersalah hilang semua memorinya. Tengku Maria terduduk sayu apabila mendapat tahu kebenaran tentang keadaan Aisyah yang sebenar. Ketika kepulangan Aisyah ke kondo yang pernah menjadi sangkar dalam hidupnya, menjadikan Aisyah seorang yang panas baran. Dia bukan lagi Aisyah yang menjadi penurut segala kata Iskandar. Pertemuan pertama selepas 4 bulan berpisah di antara Aisyah dan Iskandar, benar-benar mengejutkan Iskandar bahawa isterinya itu langsung tidak mampu untuk mengingatinya, malah pelukan pertama selepas berpisah yang di hadiahkan oleh Iskandar kepada Aisyah di balas dengan satu tumbukan kuat di perut Iskandar. Iskandar redha jika jalan ini yang harus di lalui, dia termenung panjang memikirkan bagaimana cahaya hidupnya kini sudah tidak lagi mengingatinya. Setelah 2 hari di kondo, keluarga baharu Aisyah pulah semula ke kampong, kepulangan mereka membuatkan Aisyah sakit merindu. Kini Aisyah hanya hidup dalam memori bersama keluarga baharunya itu. Berat untuk berpisah namun Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani akur dan terpaksa juga melepaskan Aisyah untuk terus bersama dengan Iskandar. Sinar bahagia buat Iskandar kini kembali tetapi tidak buat Aisyah. Iskandar mula berusaha untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah dengan setiap kenangan pahit dan manis yang pernah dilalui oleh Aisyah, namun usaha itu sering kali gagal.(n)

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Liza seakan tidak percaya apabila Nazim mengadu apa yang berlaku kepada Farah. Dia bersimpati dan dapat merasai beban yang ditanggung Farah. Mengenangkan apa yang Lukman lakukan membuatkan Farah jadi makin jauh hati. Dia mula memikirkan masa depannya dan nekad untuk meneruskan hasrat menyambut pengajian di UK demi menenangkan jiwanya.(n)

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan dan Qasih selamat melangsungkan pernikahan mereka dan masuk ke dalam bilik Jazlan cuba untuk bersyarah mengenai hukum hakam agama yang Qasih perlu lakukan tetapi Qasih terlebih dahulu menyuarakan kehendak beliau dan syarat-syarat beliau di dalam perkahwinan mereka. Selepas balik dari rumah mama Qasih, Jazlan mengarahkan Qasih untuk menutup aurat dan memakai tudung. Beberapa hari kemudian Jazlan membawa Qasih balik ke Madinah. Jazlan dan Qasih mula menjalani hidup mereka sebagai suami isteri, dengan Jazlan sentiasa menitikberatkan tanggungjawab kepada agama dan tanggungjawab isteri terhadap suami.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Keadaan Talia semakin tenat. Segalanya dibantu oleh Antasya dan Syarfan. Hubungan Aiia dan Nazarin juga semakin rapat. Nazarin sering mencuri pandang ke arah Alia. Gadis itu istimewa baginya. Najwan masih menahan diri dari terus menyukai Syafinaz dan terus menjauh sebaik sahaja dia selesai bertugas. Syarfan cuba mencuri masa bagi membawa Antasya berehat dan membeli barangan bagi menyambut bayi mereka.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Segala usaha semata untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah telah dilakukan oleh Iskandar termasuk kembali ke kampong halaman Aisyah dan bertemu dengan Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar juga melakonkan semula episode hitam di mana dia dan Aisyah di tangkap khalwat dan dipaksa untuk berkahwin. Namun semua itu adalah usaha yang sia-sia. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha gembira melihat keadaan Aisyah yang sudah hilang ingatan. Mereka semakin yakin segala harta milik arwah Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff akan jatuh ke tangan mereka. Farid pula bersenang lenang dan yakin pada malam dia mahu merogol Aisyah tidak akan diingati oleh Aisyah. Sangkaan Farid meleset apabila saat Aisyah melihat wajah Farid dia ketakutan dan mahu melindunginya sendiri. Iskandar buntu bagaimana lagi cara untuk dia mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah sehingga dia berjumpa dengan Ros di sebuah gerai. Ros tidak dapat menahan perasaannya apabila Aisyah juga tidak mampu mengingingatinya. Ros mengajak Iskandar untuk menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapa Aisyah kerana di situ lah tempat yang wajib untuk Aisyah pergi sebelum dia berkahwin dengan Iskandar. Di kubur, Aisyah menangis. Iskandar mula gembira dan menyangkakan ingatan Aisyah akan pulih.(n)

programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Salimah Mahmood berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.(n)

programme.title: Ronda Roda
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini, menampilkan kereta Chery, Tp Autoworks dan Cefiro. Yang dihoskan oleh Mira Rizam dengan mempamerkan kereta baru dari Chery Omoda 5 dan hasil tangan dari Fazreen “along” dan Syuk.(n)

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langit—yang mampu mengawal minda manusia—enam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China And America
programme.desc: Berikutan serangan hendap dalam lawatannya ke Amerika, Wong Fei-hung terpisah daripada rakan-rakan pengembaranya dan mengalami kehilangan ingatan.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: The Swindlers
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penipu bersatu untuk memburu penipu terkenal yang diketahui mati, di tengah-tengah motif tersembunyi dan penipuan mereka.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP1
programme.desc: Long Samad kemudian menceritakan kisah Zufar dan Rihana. Zufar bertemu dengan Rihana secara tidak sengaja dan tertarik dengan gadis itu. Tanpa mengetahui rahsia besar yang disembunyikan keluarga Rihana, Zufar akhirnya memilih untuk berkahwin dengannya walaupun mendapat tentangan daripada ibunya, Zahrah, dan adiknya, Lia.Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Panggilan dari luar negara untuk mendapatkan bantuan daripada anak perempuan mentor CIA McCall yang telah meninggal dunia memaksa McCall, Mel dan Harry bekerja dari jauh untuk membantu wartawan konflik itu ketika dia dikejar oleh skuad hit di Perancis. Selain itu, Mak Cik Vi menjadi curiga apabila McCall ponteng keluar pada malam keluarga lain untuk bekerja.

programme.title: Beheading
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga menjadi sasaran kemurkaan suatu entiti, memaksa mereka mempersembahkan korban kuno dengan mengahwinkan anak perempuan mereka dengan patung semangat leluhur yang tidak berkepala.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang
programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.(n)

programme.title: Lurah Dendam

Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.(n)

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantu­nya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Pontianak 100kg
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Melati, seorang gadis yang suka makan dan meninggal dunia dalam keadaan lapar. Selepas berubah menjadi pontianak, dia menghantui penduduk kampung bukan untuk menghisap darah, tetapi mencari makanan sehingga berat badannya menjadi 100kg. Penduduk kampung cuba mencari cara untuk menghentikan gangguan tersebu.

Seorang pempengaruh terkenal, Rosa segera datang membantu tapi Ryan menyangkakan Rosa mahu menculik anaknya dan merakam kejadian itu lalu memuat naik video tersebut ke sosial media. Akibatnya, nama baik Rosa tercemar. Bagi menyelamatkan namanya, pengurus Rosa menyuruh Rosa mendekati Ryan dan meminta penjelasan daripadanya.

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group "MYNT"—Sabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lo—deeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macau's unique "leisure bus" routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched "Macau History Exploration Guide," allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Running Out Of Time
programme.desc: Hua, who only has fourteen days to live, decides to play a seventy-two-hour game with the police, robbing a jewelry company and taking hostages. Officer Sheng suspects Hua's actions are aimed at him, and after several twists and turns, Hua is finally apprehended. In reality, Hua and Sheng secretly share a mutual respect; knowing Hua's days are numbered, Sheng devises a plan to release him….

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022

The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 & Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Scoop 2026

The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces.".

programme.title: Thai Rogered (Sr.11)
programme.desc: "Thailand expert" Hu Huichong once again leads the "Tom Yum Family" members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, "Bobo" Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides "unboxing" hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached children's playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the 'King of Ghosts' Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of 'Spirit Connection,' with the team closely following live broadcasts,.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces.".

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: Thai Rogered (Sr.11)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out ….(n)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.(n)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.(n)

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group "MYNT"—Sabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lo—deeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macau's unique "leisure bus" routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched "Macau History Exploration Guide," allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.(n)

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.(n)

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.(n)

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung (Liu Wai Hung) was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por (Lam Ka Tung). One day, they met the beautiful Dip (Gigi Fu) and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dip's maid Ngor (Esther Kwan). Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho (Chan Mui Hing). Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again….(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Episode 19 Posing as Biaozi, Han Feng conducts a deal with A-She and Mr. Meng. Qi Sizhe realizes that the drug chemist on the phone is an impostor, so the task force follows the trail to the larger network. Elsewhere, Wang Bo detonates a bomb while fleeing, leaving Zhu Qingyue gravely injured and unconscious. Wang is captured and confesses to several silencing murders. A-She is then killed, and the condition of his body, including signs of hydrofluoric-acid exposure, leads investigators to Feng Zhengxi's glass factory. Wang admits that A-She wanted to bypass Feng and contact Nuo Sha directly. Police raid the drug-production site; Feng escapes, but an underground laboratory is uncovered.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals….(n)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love.".(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Episode 20 The handwriting in the glass factory's drug-manufacturing notes matches that of Qi Sizhe's mentor, Wu Yongchang, on corrections to Qi's thesis. A key molecular formula is also hidden in an anatomy book left by Li Ming. Wu insists he was only developing medicine for his wife, who has depression, but both disappear, and police conclude that Feng Zhengxi kidnapped them. Qi lures the enemy by threatening to publish the notes. After receiving a demand to exchange the formula for his mentor, he goes alone to the meeting, where his tracker is removed and he is taken to the factory. Han Feng tracks down the contact, A-Sen, and arrests him after a gunfight.(n)

programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung (Liu Wai Hung) was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por (Lam Ka Tung). One day, they met the beautiful Dip (Gigi Fu) and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dip's maid Ngor (Esther Kwan). Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho (Chan Mui Hing). Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again….(n)

programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Episode 20 The handwriting in the glass factory's drug-manufacturing notes matches that of Qi Sizhe's mentor, Wu Yongchang, on corrections to Qi's thesis. A key molecular formula is also hidden in an anatomy book left by Li Ming. Wu insists he was only developing medicine for his wife, who has depression, but both disappear, and police conclude that Feng Zhengxi kidnapped them. Qi lures the enemy by threatening to publish the notes. After receiving a demand to exchange the formula for his mentor, he goes alone to the meeting, where his tracker is removed and he is taken to the factory. Han Feng tracks down the contact, A-Sen, and arrests him after a gunfight.(n)

programme.title: Doctor is sick
programme.desc: Produced by the team behind News Hotline, this show flips the script on medical series by focusing on doctors who become patients themselves. It follows healthcare professionals as they face serious illnesses and health crises, highlighting how they handle vulnerability, diagnosis, and personal struggle behind the white coat.(n)

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.(n)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love.".(n)

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Episode 21 Qi Sizhe exposes Wu Yongchang as the chemist behind the new drug and deliberately hands over an incomplete formula to buy time. Using soil Qi left behind, police locate the factory in a valley. Han Feng poses as Nuo Sha during the deal and signals the full assault. In the ensuing firefight, A-Sen shoots and kills Lin Guifen, while Feng Zhengxi is captured. Wu admits that three years earlier he anonymously reported Li Ming and caused Yu Fei's death. In the end, he chooses not to detonate the bomb and surrenders. The massive Original Diamond case is finally solved, and the two principal criminals are brought to justice. Han Feng and Qi Sizhe pay tribute to Yu Fei and decide to continue working cases side by side.(n)

programme.title: Jue Mi Shi Ming
programme.desc: In the early 1930s, the Communist Party established a top-secret underground route connecting Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shantou, and Fujian to their main base in Ruijin to bypass severe military blockades. Disguised as ordinary shopkeepers, boatmen, and doctors, covert couriers risked their lives to outsmart enemy forces. Together, they smuggled vital intelligence, essential supplies, and safely escorted key leaders—including Zhou Enlai—across enemy lines.

programme.desc: Explore Taiwan's coastlines, rivers and offshore islands through fishing adventures led by experienced hosts and local experts. Each episode introduces distinctive fishing grounds, regional techniques and the people whose lives are connected to the water.(n)

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.(n)

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.(n)

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.(n)

programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.(n)
